{{Quote|Lord Grathan is a paranoid madman. His compound is built to withstand a siege.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]]|<ref name="TOR:FC">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Family Cleansing|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
This '''estate''' was owned by rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Grathan]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It served as his warehouse where his guard protected artifacts and relics. During the apprenticeship of [[Darth Nox|Kallig's descendant]] to [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash]], the apprentice was assigned to [[Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|infiltrate]] the bunker and acquire both a [[Trandoshan relic|tablet]] and the [[cyber neutralizer]], a prototype weapon, developed by the scientist [[Dorotsech]], to help them defeat Darth Skotia. The young apprentice performed the task successfully.<ref name="Kaas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The estate first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]]<ref name="Kaas" /> released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref>
